rps_confirmatory_blog.export_note: Per-response entropy evidence compacted to passed/errors/raw evidence digest; complete private receipt pinned by SHA256. No digest normalization or retry. Stock Ruby, before unpublished token prefix/suffix fix.

rps_gc_diagnostic.scope: Two bounded diagnostic probes, not pricing or a causal p99 intervention; all three arms retained.
rps_gc_diagnostic.cause: Observed diagnostic GCs are allocation-slot exhaustion, not old-gen/malloc/ISeq retention pressure; the confirmatory excess-major/p99 cause remains unproven.
limitations: Observers alter heap growth/history; the lower-overhead follow-up reverses the collection-rate ordering and neither reproduces load-phase major GCs.
GC::Profiler readings and per-event snapshots allocate; profile-count versus counter-window differences are retained.
Rack-time GC correlation excludes Puma/transport/queue delay; no causal intervention or new price.
Forced full GC and heap dumps occur only after the diagnosed load; retained counts include diagnostic records.
Certificate graph sizes are per-unit upper bounds, not additive with @data aliases or whole-worker differences.
No compaction/freezing/GC tuning or runtime fix is justified or applied.

rps_current_main_gc_tagged.scope: orb HTTP/Puma baseline; exact Rack samples, not own-suite or DB-state certification
rps_current_main_gc_tagged.launcher_limitation: After all 60 windows and result.json completed, the supervised one-shot launcher restarted; duplicate-output guard rejected later launches before app boot. They overwrote only launcher elapsed/log sidecars. Receipt span uses protocol-to-result file mtimes, not a recovered exact launcher duration. All original per-window receipts and result remain intact; no measured retry or exclusions.
rps_current_main_gc_tagged.export_note: All rounds retained. Full private oha/CSV/pcap receipts hashed; entropy traces compacted without normalization. Observer CPU is accounting, not an overhead ablation; wire spans are not oha request joins or pure queue times.
rps_current_main_gc_tagged.attribution_conclusion: The historical resolved p99 excess does not reproduce (current paired p99 -7.575%, CI -19.628 to +5.878); higher GC frequency still coexists with fewer objects. Roughly 95-99% of per-window wire-tail requests overlap a recorded pause, mostly before Rack; >99% spend over half their wire span outside Rack. GC overlap and queue/remainder are not mutually exclusive. Recorded pauses account for substantial tail overlap but do not establish the historical excess cause or the token/guard fixes as its cure.
